name: fab-library-advisor
description: Suggest relevant assets from each user's own Fab library during Unreal Engine work.

interface.shortDescription: Recommend assets from your own Fab library.
interface.longDescription: Searches owned assets through the official UE 5.9 Fab toolset or the UE 5.8 My Library window, recommends owned assets, auto-indexes verified catalog misses before requested downloads, and checks once daily for verified plugin updates.
defaultPrompt: Search my owned assets using the official Fab toolset on UE 5.9 or my private catalog and the My Library window on UE 5.8.
When I request a download, verify and index a catalog-missing owned asset first.
For Unreal assets, select the exact project engine version or the newest version Fab explicitly supports.
Check for a Fab Library Advisor update when the daily check is due.
Check my owned Fab assets for this Unreal task.
Recommend owned assets that fit the current map.
